cards.name: Snivy
cards.description: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.description: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.description: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.description: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.description: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

cards.name: Snivy
cards.description: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.description: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.description: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.description: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

cards.name: Axew
cards.description: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

cards.name: Genesect
cards.description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.description: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are know to relieve stress.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.description: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.description: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.description: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.description: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

cards.name: Axew
cards.description: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.description: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.description: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.description: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Serperior
cards.description: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

cards.name: Emboar
cards.description: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

cards.name: Samurott
cards.description: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.description: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.description: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.description: It immediately headbutts anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.

cards.name: Axew
cards.description: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.description: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

cards.name: Victini
cards.description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.description: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

cards.name: Thundurus
cards.description: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

cards.name: Tornadus
cards.description: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

cards.name: Landorus
cards.description: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.description: It generates powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.description: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

cards.name: Lilligant
cards.description: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.description: Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.description: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.description: Known as "The Desert Spirit," this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.description: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.description: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

cards.name: Haxorus
cards.description: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

cards.name: Black Kyurem
cards.description: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: White Kyurem
cards.description: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: Keldeo
cards.description: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.description: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.description: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.description: Many famous songs have been inspired by the melodies that Meloetta plays.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.description: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.description: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

cards.name: Cobalion
cards.description: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

cards.name: Darkrai
cards.description: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.description: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.description: With four linked brains, it's more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

cards.name: Landorus
cards.description: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.description: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.description: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

cards.name: Genesect
cards.description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.description: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.description: Inhaled air is heated in the flame sac in its body to an intense fire over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.description: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can melt away into water.

cards.name: Glaceon
cards.description: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.description: If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its fur and launch it in small bunches.

cards.name: Espeon
cards.description: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.description: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Mew
cards.description: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

cards.description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.
